title: Measuring Unfairness through Game-Theoretic Interpretability
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on assessing fairness in machine learning models by comparing fairness metrics with feature importance measures (specifically SHAP), using sensitive attributes such as race, gender, and age.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of the study.
